videos.title: Tesla shareholders... we've got a major situation on our hands..
videos.subtitle_summary:
Tesla shareholders were informed of significant changes that occurred within the company over the past 72 hours. These rapid changes highlight how quickly Tesla is reshaping its business. Here are five key changes:
1. Elon Musk announced at a self-driving event on May 19th that Tesla would expand Full Self-Driving (FSD) services to the entire United States by the end of 2026, emphasizing the term "unsupervised." Currently, FSD vehicles require a safety driver in the car.
2. Musk initially suggested in April that the timeline for FSD would be Q4 2026, but at the May event, he accelerated the timeline to expand FSD services within the year.
3. Musk also claimed that FSD will eventually be safer than human-driven cars, contradicting his previous statement six weeks ago that FSD is already safer and backed by statistics.
4. Tesla unveiled a new energy storage product, the Megapack 3 and Megablock, an evolution of the existing Megapack. The Megapack 3 weighs approximately 39 tons, operates from 40 to 60 degrees, and has a lifespan of over 25 years and 1 million cycles.
5. However, the focus of attention is on the Megablock, which integrates the Megapack 3, power conversion equipment, and switching gear into one system. It provides 20MW capacity in a single unit. Tesla claims that the Megablock offers 23% faster installation speed and up to 40% increased energy density compared to existing products.
These changes have caused market reactions as they shift the focus from Elon Musk's statements to actual deployment speeds and data reliability in the self-driving car debate. Additionally, Tesla introduced a new energy storage product, the Megapack 3 and Megablock, which offers faster installation speed and increased energy density compared to existing products.

videos.subtitle_summary:
1. Samsung Electronics와 노조가 합의한 성과급 계획에 따르면, 사업 성과는 10.5%로 정해져 있으나 실제로는 영업 이익을 중심으로 받아들이고 있다.
2. 이 계획은 주주의 권리를 침하며, 경제적 부가 가치 기준을 사용해야 한다는 주장이 있으며, 선진국에서도 영업 이익이 아닌 경제적 부가 가치를 기준으로 하고 있다.
3. 이 문제로 인해 다른 대업 노조들도 성과급 제도 개편을 요구하고 있으며, 현대차 노조는 지난해 순위익의 30%를 성과금으로 지급하는 방안을 제시했다.
